records.Name: One Time Donors-Thank You Email
records.Subject: Thank You for Your Generous Support
records.HtmlValue:
Dear {{{Recipient.Name_For_Email__c}}}

Thank you for your generous donation and for supporting SOS Children’s Villages in Ethiopia. Your kindness is helping children and families build a brighter future.

We would love to invite you to continue making a lasting impact by becoming a committed giver through our Sponsorship Program. Your ongoing support can change a child’s life for the long term.

Register here to become a sponsor: [Insert Web Form]

Thank you again for being part of this mission.

Warm regards,

records.Name: Welcome Email Communication
records.Subject: Welcome to SOS Children’s Villages in Ethiopia
records.HtmlValue:
Dear {{{Recipient.Name_For_Email__c}}}, 

Thank you for registering as a [Child/Family/Program/Foster Care] Sponsor and for making your first contribution through [Credit Card/Payment Gateway/Mobile Payment]. 

We are truly grateful to welcome you to the SOS Children’s Villages in Ethiopia family. Your support will help us continue providing care, protection, and opportunities for children and families in need. 

Our Sponsorship Team will send you your welcome package within the next 48 hours with more information about your sponsorship journey. 

Thank you for choosing to make a lasting difference. 

Warm regards, 

Beza Teklu

records.Name: One Time Donors-Learn More
records.Subject: See the Impact of Your Support
records.HtmlValue:
Dear {{{Recipient.Name_For_Email__c}}},

Thank you once again for your generous support to SOS Children’s Villages in Ethiopia. We would love to invite you to learn more about our work, programs, and the lives we reach through our publications,
including our Annual Report and inspiring Impact Stories.

Read more here: [Insert Link]

Thank you for being part of our community.

Warm regards,

records.Name: Payment Confirmation
records.Subject: Thank You – We Received Your Contribution
records.HtmlValue:
Dear {{{Recipient.FirstName}}}, 

We are pleased to confirm that we have received your first contribution. 

Thank you for taking this meaningful step. Your support is already making a difference in a child’s life. 

We deeply appreciate your trust and partnership. 

Warm regards, 

Beza Teklu

records.Name: Birthday Email
records.Subject: Today is a Special Day
records.HtmlValue:
Dear {{{Recipient.Name_For_Email__c}}}

Happy Birthday!  

On this special day, we want to celebrate your kindness, generosity, and the love you share with the child you support. You are truly making a difference, and we hope your day is full of joy and happiness. 

Wishing you a wonderful year ahead! 

Warmly, 
Beza Teklu

records.Name: Anniversary Email (1 Year Sponsorship Milestone)
records.Subject: One Year of Changing Lives
records.HtmlValue:
Dear {{{Recipient.Name_For_Email__c}}} 

Can you believe it has been a whole year since you started sponsoring a child? I want to personally congratulate you on this milestone. 

Your kindness and commitment have made such a real difference. Because of you, a child has felt cared for, safe, and supported and that is something truly extraordinary. I am so grateful to have you as part of our SOS family. 

With gratitude, 
Beza Teklu

records.Name: Mid-Year Report (PDF)
records.Subject: Mid-Year Report 2026
records.HtmlValue:
Dear {{{Recipient.Name_For_Email__c}}}, 

I hope this message finds you well. 

It brings me great joy to share a mid-year update about the child you sponsor. Your support is building more than a future; it is creating joy in the present. 

Thank you for standing by our side. 

I hope you enjoy your reading! 

Best, 

Beza Teklu

records.Name: End of Year Report (Year) PDF
records.Subject: End of Year Report (Year)
records.HtmlValue:
Dear {{{Recipient.Name_For_Email__c}}}

I am pleased to share an update on your child. In the attached report, you will find a one paragraph about your child, along with two stories that highlight the positive progress taking place in the community your child calls home. A recent photograph of your child is also included. 

I hope you enjoy reading the stories. 

Thank you sincerely for your continued generosity and support. 

Warm regards, 

Beza Teklu

records.Name: Reminder 1 (1 month after missed payment)
records.Subject: Friendly Reminder About Your Sponsorship
records.HtmlValue:
Dear {{{Recipient.Name_For_Email__c}}}

I noticed your recent contribution may not have gone through. I understand that this can happen. 

Please let me know if you need any assistance. 

Warm regards 

Beza Teklu

records.Name: Reminder 2 (2 month after missed payment)
records.Subject: Kind Reminder: Pending Contribution
records.HtmlValue:
Dear {{{Recipient.FirstName}}}, 

We have not yet received your recent contributions and wanted to gently follow up. 

Your support means so much, and I am here to assist if needed. 

Warm regards, 
Beza Teklu

records.Name: Reminder 3 (3 month after missed payment)
records.Subject: Important Update Regarding Your Sponsorship
records.HtmlValue:
Dear {{{Recipient.FirstName}}},

As we have not received contributions for the past three months, your sponsorship may be at risk of temporary suspension. 

Please contact us at your earliest convenience so I can support you. 

Warm regards, 
Beza Teklu

records.Name: Cancellation Process
records.Subject: Confirmation of Sponsorship Cancellation
records.HtmlValue:
Dear {{{Recipient.Name_For_Email__c}}}

We are very sorry to lose you as a sponsor, but of course, we respect your wish to end your commitment. 

We herewith confirm the cancellation of your sponsorship with SOS Children’s Villages in Ethiopia. We would like to take this opportunity to thank you very much for your support. 

If you have in any way been dissatisfied with your sponsorship or have comments on any aspect of our work, we would greatly appreciate it if you could let us know. 

We wish you all the best in your future endeavours, and you are of course always welcome to join us in our efforts again. 

If you wish to resume your sponsorship in the future, please use the following link: https://forms.office.com/r/n1ckjWfLkW 

  
Best wishes, 
Beza Teklu

records.Name: Thank you email after IV payment
records.Subject: Thank you for staying with us
records.HtmlValue:
Dear [[Name_For_Email]],  

Your continued generosity inspires us. 

Thank you for your fourth donation and for remaining committed to our mission. Your support enables us to continue working alongside children, young people and families to build brighter futures. 

We are truly grateful for your partnership. 

With sincere appreciation, 

SOS Children's Villages in Ethiopia

records.Name: Welcome the new donor CG
records.Subject: Welcome to the SOS Children's Villages family
records.HtmlValue:
Dear [[Name_For_Email]],

Thank you for becoming a valued supporter of SOS Children's Villages in Ethiopia. 

Your first donation has been received, and we are delighted to welcome you to our community of supporters. Your generosity helps children and young people without parental care or at risk of losing it receive the care, protection and support they need to become their strongest selves. 

We are grateful to have you with us on this journey. Together, we can help create lasting change in the lives of children and families. 

Thank you for your kindness and commitment. 

Warm regards, 
SOS Children's Villages in Ethiopia

records.Name: Thank you email after the II payment
records.Subject: Thank you for your continued support
records.HtmlValue:
Dear [[Name_For_Email]], 

Thank you for your continued generosity. 

Your second donation reflects your growing commitment to supporting children and young people. Because of supporters like you, we can continue providing tailored care and strengthening families to help children thrive. 

We sincerely appreciate your trust and support. 

With gratitude, 

SOS Children's Villages in Ethiopia

records.Name: Thank you email after III payment
records.Subject: Your support is making a difference
records.HtmlValue:
Dear [[Name_For_Email]], 

Thank you for making your third donation. 

Your ongoing support means so much to us and to the children, young people and families we serve. Every contribution helps provide opportunities for children to grow up in a safe and caring environment. 

Thank you for standing with us and making a lasting difference. 

Warm regards, 

SOS Children's Villages in Ethiopia

records.Name: Thank you email after VI payment
records.Subject: Six months of creating brighter futures together
records.HtmlValue:

Thank you for making six successful donations. Your consistent support is helping children and young people receive the care, relationships and opportunities they need to build brighter futures. 

We are honoured to have you as part of the SOS Children's Villages family and look forward to continuing this journey together. 

Thank you for your compassion and generosity. 

Warm regards, 

SOS Children's Villages in Ethiopia

records.Name: Thank you email after 12 payments
records.Subject: One year of impact—thank you!
records.HtmlValue:

Thank you for making twelve successful donations and for standing with children and young people throughout the past year. Your commitment has helped create lasting opportunities and hope for those who need it most. 

Your generosity makes a meaningful difference, and we are deeply grateful for your trust and partnership. 

Thank you for being part of this journey. 

With heartfelt appreciation, 

SOS Children's Villages in Ethiopia
